name.ja: <ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby><ruby>幻<rt>げん</rt></ruby><ruby>学<rt>がく</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt>と</rt></ruby>アルス＝マグナ

text.en:
(This card is always treated as an "Artmage" card.)
Your activated "Medius" monsters' effects cannot be negated. If you have a "Power Patron" monster in your GY: You can banish 1 Fusion, Synchro, or Xyz Monster from your GY, and declare 1 "Ars Magna" Link Monster Card name that has not been declared for "Ars Magna Academic Arcane Apparition Acropolis" this turn; Special Summon that monster from your Extra Deck, but it cannot be used as Link Material.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名在规则上也视为“神艺”卡。①：自己发动的“墨迪乌斯”怪兽的效果不会被无效化。②：自己墓地存在“狱神”怪兽的情况下，从自己墓地将1只融合・同步・超量怪兽除外，宣言1个“奥艺”连接怪兽的卡名可以发动（此回合，不可为发动此卡名的此效果而宣言相同卡名）。从额外牌组将1只所宣言的怪兽特殊召唤。以此效果特殊召唤的怪兽不可作为连接素材。
